The MonStars

The MonStars are a fun-fuelled indie pop & rock powerhouse with killer vocals, glam rock falsettos, and a playlist packed with Britpop bangers & floor-fillers.

About The MonStars

The MonStars are a high-octane 3–4 piece indie pop &amp; rock band bringing unstoppable energy , serious talent , and a party-starting setlist to every event. From Britpop classics to modern indie bangers , this band has a knack for getting everyone on the floor — and keeping them there. Fronted by the magnetic Edwin , whose jaw-dropping vocal range , cheeky charm, and dancefloor-commanding energy have wowed everyone from festival-goers to Britain’s Got Talent producers, The MonStars are pure entertainment. Edwin particularly nails the big falsetto moments in glam rock classics , making tunes by Queen, The Darkness, or Scissor Sisters soar with flair and authenticity. He’s backed by Chris on bass, Jake on lead guitar, and Dan on drums — each one a seasoned pro with impressive credits from Abbey Road to global tours . This band blends technical skill with on-stage charisma, creating a live experience that’s as slick as it is exhilarating. With over 200 songs spanning indie, pop-rock, funk, soul, and Christmas anthems, The MonStars can tailor your setlist and even learn your special song. They’re also known for following every brief to the letter , while always going above and beyond to create an electric atmosphere on the night. A manned playlist between sets keeps the disco vibes flowing , and the band comes fully equipped with professional PA and lighting . Just book, brief, and get ready to dance — The MonStars will take care of the rest .
